meta.name: voice-of-customer
meta.description: Builds the loop from what customers say to what gets changed — collecting feedback, distinguishing signal from noise, routing it to owners, and closing the loop back to the customer. Use this to set up a feedback program, design or interpret CSAT/NPS, decide what customer feedback deserves action, get product to act on recurring issues, or diagnose why feedback is collected but nothing changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 建立从客户声音到产品变更的反馈闭环
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果产品团队收集了客户反馈却迟迟没有行动。
copy.tagline_en: Build a closed loop from customer voice to product change.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team gathers feedback but struggles to act on it.

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 能指导你搭建完整的客户反馈闭环:收集反馈、分清主次、指派负责人,并把改动结果告诉客户,同时点出常见陷阱。
howto.when: 当你需要设置反馈机制、解读满意度调查或决定哪些反馈值得处理时;也可用于诊断「收集了反馈却没有改变」的原因。

say.text: 帮我设计一套客户反馈收集流程
say.note: 它会建议数据源和加权方式。
引导你关注趋势和自由文本。

say.text: 客户老说加载慢,怎么推动改版?
say.note: 帮你算影响并找到负责人。

howto.what_en: This skill lets Claude guide you through building a full customer feedback loop: collect feedback, separate signal from noise, assign owners, close the loop with customers, and avoid common traps.
howto.when_en: Use when setting up a feedback program, interpreting CSAT/NPS, deciding which feedback deserves action, or diagnosing why collected feedback leads to no change.

say_en.text: Help me design a customer feedback collection process.
How should I read this NPS result?
say_en.note: Leads you to trends and free text.

say_en.text: Customers keep saying loading is slow; how do we drive a fix?
say_en.note: Estimates impact and finds an owner.
